Civil rights lawyer Harmeet Dhillon joins Tucker Carlson to argue that the Justice Department has targeted white Christians. Dhillon, a prominent Republican attorney, says the pattern is worse than most people think. She presents her case as a civil rights fight from the right.

Dhillon walks through cases she says show biased enforcement, from church surveillance to protest charges. She argues that equal law means protecting unpopular groups too. Carlson asks why so few in the media cover the pattern she describes. Concerned viewers get a lawyer's brief against the department she is exposing.
